origin.project: Project Y2K ('Two Fronts'), the owner's game project (private); generated from a Ginkgo session
records: runs/twofronts/meshy/README.md and ProjectY2K docs/MESHY_NOTES.md (task ledger, rounds 1 and 2)

external_reference_status: Text prompts only: no image was given to any stage.
variant_suffix: generated Y2K prop; detailed geometry edition
dimension_basis: Heights are the target heights at which Project Y2K's Neon Front scene placed each prop (twofronts/world/place_assets.py: planter pod 1.1 m, vending machine 2.4 m, kiosk 2.6 m, holo sign 3.4 m, hover scooter 1.2 m, hover car 1.6 m); Meshy's OBJ units are arbitrary, so each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height and its width and depth measured after scaling. Y2K's later ginkgo_props_v061 pass used 1.9 m for the vending machine and 1.78 m for the scooter. Speculative designs; not a physical survey.
rights: Meshy-6 text-to-3D preview and refine on the owner's Meshy account on 2026-09-06 (the same account, by the account ID in the result URLs, as the library's other Meshy batches). This was the account's first recorded use (MESHY_NOTES: balance 3,320 credits, no prior tasks). Whether the account was on a paid plan on 2026-09-06 is unknown: neither MESHY_NOTES, the Ginkgo README nor session b7a7d8b6 records the plan, and paid status is not asserted here; the owner should confirm it. Text prompts only. Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)"). Provider textures are not distributed.
estimated_credits: 0 for this import (generation already paid: 20 Meshy credits per preview, 10 per refine)
